title: Monomorphisms of abelian sheaves are detected on stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups on $X$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], with stalks and stalk maps as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then $\varphi$ is a monomorphism if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the induced stalk map $\varphi_x:F_x\to G_x$ is a monomorphism of abelian groups (equivalently, injective).

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 007S (exactness at points), monomorphism clause; Mathlib Topology/Sheaves/Stalks.lean theorem mono_iff_stalk_mono
